title: FIS BI Forms Library customer questionnaire
description: Structural shape of a form's questionnaire.json: the six-language Client Portal question set, plus the fieldBindings contract that engine/lib/field-bindings.js interprets to turn questionnaire-shaped answers into a flat field-key map. Cross-file consistency against the form's coordinate-map.json (every referenced field key must exist and have compatible roles; a question that only informs a staff-controlled field must not be wired to auto-populate it) is checked separately by engine/lib/config-consistency.js, not by this schema.

languages.description: Every form must at minimum offer English; other entries are the site's five additional supported locales.

dataKey.description: Key this question's answer is stored under in the data object passed to resolveFieldValues(). Required for every type except repeatable-group, which uses groupDataKey instead.

options.description: For type:select -- the allowed answer values (matched against fieldBindings.checkboxSelect[].options keys, or consumed directly as a direct-passthrough field value).

forFields.description: coordinate-map.json field keys this question's answer ultimately populates (directly, or via fieldBindings). Used for cross-file consistency checking -- every key here must exist in the form's coordinate-map.json.

informsStaffOnly.description: True when this question collects customer input that FIS staff review and manually decide what (if anything) to write onto the official PDF -- the answer is never auto-drawn onto any field. Required to be true for any question whose forFields are all staff-owned/suppliedBy:staff fields.

groupDataKey.description: For type:repeatable-group -- the array key in the data object (data[groupDataKey] is an array of per-entry objects).

maxCount.description: For type:repeatable-group -- the maximum number of entries the underlying PDF has physical rows for. resolveFieldValues() throws if more entries are supplied than this.

subQuestions.description: For type:repeatable-group -- the per-entry question set, applied to each item in data[groupDataKey].
